apps.name: MES Store
apps.description: Discover, download, and manage your MES apps in one place.
apps.releaseNotes:
MES Store 1.1.0

Four bottom tabs: Featured, Apps, Tutorial, and Settings.

Featured introduces apps with large illustrated cards that open dedicated app pages. Apps lists the complete catalog with search and installed/update filters. Tutorial is empty for now.

Settings includes automatic daily update checks, optional automatic downloads, an unmetered-connection preference, installation permission, and downloaded-file cleanup. Downloads survive a store restart and are verified again before installation.

Android still asks before installing updates. Automatic downloads prepare updates without interrupting work in your other apps. The transparent MES Store icon is unchanged.

apps.name: SignPad
apps.description: Sign bills of lading, scan shipments, and keep warehouse work moving.
apps.releaseNotes:
SignPad 1.6.1

Back from the driver step restores the shipper's handwriting for review or correction. Includes the inspection and loading workflow and signed BOL printing integration.

Install over the existing SignPad app to keep pairing and authorization. MES authorization is required to access company data.
